description: This Java class 'SubscriptionManager' manages search subscriptions over WebSocket connections or persistence actors. It handles creating, requesting, and cancelling subscriptions, manages subscription actors, and coordinates search source streams using Akka Streams. The class also handles parsing options, generating subscription IDs, and forwarding commands between actors.

classes.name: SubscriptionManager
classes.description: An Akka actor managing search subscriptions, handling creation, requests, cancellations, and streaming of search data.

methods.name: cancelSubscription

methods.name: forwardToChild
methods.description: Forwards commands to child subscription actors or responds with errors if not found.

methods.name: createSubscription
